title: Electric Service Agreement Tariff Rules: Disconnection for Nonpayment
content:
These tariff rules of Lakeshore Power & Light Company govern disconnection for nonpayment under the **Electric Service Agreement**, on every schedule. Where a clause names a schedule figure, the figure is the one set for the agreement's schedule.

## Rule 1. Grounds
1.1 Service is disconnected for nonpayment only under a pending written notice and only when no protection applies.
1.2 A notice that expires without disconnection is rescinded, and a new written notice is needed before any later disconnection.

## Rule 2. Permitted dates
2.1 Disconnection may not be performed before the earliest disconnect date on the written notice.
2.2 Disconnection may not be performed after the notice validity period that follows the earliest disconnect date.
2.3 Both limits are counted in calendar days from the earliest disconnect date, which itself is a permitted disconnection date, and the last day of the validity period is still permitted. The opening limit lies 0 calendar days after the earliest disconnect date: the earliest disconnect date itself, 0 days after it, is permitted. The validity period runs for the schedule's notice validity period in calendar days.
2.4 Both limits are taken from the earliest disconnect date recorded on that written notice in the company's records.
2.5 A final notice must have been delivered at least the schedule's final notice lead time, in hours, earlier.
2.6 No disconnection is performed on the schedule's disconnection-prohibited days.

Hypothetical dates (earliest disconnect date 10 March; a validity period of 10 days chosen only for illustration):

| Proposed date | Position | Rule 2 result |
|---|---|---|
| 9 March | the day before the earliest disconnect date | not permitted |
| 10 March | the earliest disconnect date, 0 days after it | permitted |
| 20 March | the last day of the validity period | permitted |
| 21 March | the day after the validity period | not permitted; the notice is rescinded and a new written notice is needed |

## Rule 3. Winter moratorium
During the schedule's winter moratorium period, a residential account whose space heating is electric is not disconnected for nonpayment. The account's recorded space heating decides; an account recorded with non-electric space heating is not held back by this rule. Whether the moratorium applies on a schedule, and its calendar window, are schedule figures.

## Rule 4. Medical and arrangement protections
No disconnection is performed while a medical postponement for the agreement is running, while a medical certification for the agreement whose kind bars disconnection is active, before the personal contact attempts that an active medical certification requires have been made, or while a payment arrangement on the agreement is active. Postponements and certifications are records of the Medical and Life-Support Protections program; arrangements are records of the Payment Arrangement program.
